Docs / Review pull requests

Review pull requests

Understand the change, discuss it privately, and choose what to publish.

Review a pull request

  1. Open Pull requests and filter, or search by title, #number, or @author.
  2. Read checks and activity in PR. Inspect files in WorkBench → Changes.
  3. Select diff lines, choose Add to review, then Submit review.
  4. Merge from the header when checks allow. Monitor PR follows updates.

Post now and Reply publish at once; Add to review keeps comments pending until you submit.

Explore code and tests

For a watched PR, open WorkBench → Tears of time → Create worktree to explore. It opens a local editor and starts no agent.

  • Shift twice or ⌘⇧F searches everywhere; ⌘F searches the file.
  • A test’s play button runs or debugs it.

On your own PR, Development task opens or creates its agent task.

Ask for a private review

Watch the repository and pick a ready Review model first.

  1. Choose WorkBench → Summary → Start review, or Review changes in a task.
  2. Read What changed and the findings. Ask reviewer opens a private discussion.
  3. Add to my review turns a finding into a comment you publish with Submit review. Request fix → Send to developer asks the development agent to fix it instead.
  4. Review latest checks new commits.

If a review could not finish, use Resume review.

Ask from a review card

  1. On someone else’s review comment, choose Ask agent and ask about it.
  2. Draft with agent writes a reply that stays private until you choose Comment.

Resolve locally closes only the private discussion. On a development task’s PR, Fix with agent sends the comment to that task’s agent.

Preview PR and issue links

Hover a PR or issue link to see its title, status, and description. Drag the card to keep it open; Escape closes it.

Browse web pages

Choose New page in the Web pages column and enter an address, or type words to search Google. Pin keeps a page after restart, and ⌘F finds text on it. Back to app keeps the page open.
